quarterly_data.quarter: Vicor press release: Vicor licenses VPD to a leading AI OEM (09-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Vicor granted a non-exclusive license to a new OEM licensee (not named; the headline calls it 'a leading AI OEM') with the right to procure Vertical Power Delivery (VPD) modules covered by Vicor patents from unlicensed suppliers. VPD solutions using high current density MCM current multipliers manufactured as ChiPs in a Vicor fab are also available to licensees; by procuring VPD modules for high-performance AI accelerators from Vicor, licensees may earn substantial discounts on licensing royalties for commodity VPD modules from unlicensed suppliers. Vicor says potential licensees may expect a structured licensing practice with much lower royalty rates for early adopters, and that unlicensed OEMs and hyperscalers may need a license to secure their supply chain as processors migrate to VPD.
